tasks.task: Plan bundles and add-ons that raise order value

items.when: When you have order history and costs and need bundles and add-ons with the margin of each
Before you design anything, to see which pairs and triples people already buy together
When one product could sell as good, better and best, to lay out three tiers with savings wording
When a hero product suits buy-more-save-more, to try quantity breaks against a fixed bundle
When add-ons must be placed in the cart and checkout, one offer per slot, ranked by profit
Before a bundle goes live, to check every part is in stock and how many you can really sell
When a bundle is only a discount and needs a reason the buyer would want it at full price

tasks.task: Set a free shipping threshold

items.when: When you have order sizes and need the threshold set just above where real orders cluster
When you must show the threshold still leaves margin after the shipping you give away
When free shipping costs too much, to try spend-and-get gift tiers instead
When the owner wants threshold, bundles and an after-sale offer worked out in one run

tasks.task: Design the category tree and menu

items.when: When the store needs a category tree in shoppers' words with the attributes each one needs
When you want a second cut of collections, filters and menu from the product list to compare
When the tree is agreed and you need the menu, sub-collection links and breadcrumbs
When the menu labels are drafted, to rate each choice and rewrite the unclear ones
When the tree has grown levels and labels nobody needs and must be cut to what helps

tasks.task: Fix filters and attribute values

items.when: When shoppers cannot narrow down, filters show odd values or products vanish under a filter
When each category needs its attributes, allowed values and filter order written down
When material, size and spec fields must be filled on live products so filters have data
When sizes and colours are spelt several ways and must be set to one standard

tasks.task: Write a product data template and variant rules

items.when: When new items need one sheet with every field, its allowed values and the tag rules
When you must decide what is a product and what is a variant, with a fill-in checklist
When live products miss barcode, SKU, vendor or weight and the gaps must be found and filled

tasks.task: Move the current catalogue to a new structure

items.when: When filters are messy, a big range is coming or the store is moving platform
When every product needs a standard category so feeds and shopping tools can place it
After the move and each month, to find missing costs, clashing codes and hidden products

tasks.task: Clean a messy product list before import

items.when: When a supplier sheet is messy and must be fixed and re-checked until it passes
When titles are inconsistent and you need tidy ones with a before and after sheet
Before import, to find products sharing a code or barcode that would mix stock and orders
After import, to list products and variants with no image or too few

tasks.task: Turn feed diagnostics into a ranked fix list

items.when: When the issue list is long and you need to know in ten minutes what to fix first and where
When you need each issue with products affected, the cause in the data and where to fix it
When you want Google feed problems ranked by lost sales, with a score to track
When the account has a warning and you must rank each gap by suspension risk

tasks.task: Write feed title and attribute rewrite rules

items.when: When missing size, colour or gender must come from a supplemental feed or a feed rule
When titles are codes or vague and you have the search terms that convert
When you want a second title pattern in one fixed word order to compare on a sample
After the new titles load, to see that no new issues appeared

tasks.task: Run the monthly feed health check

items.when: Each month, and two to three weeks before any big sale
When this month's diagnostics are in and you need the short list first
When issues point at returns, shipping or contact pages that are missing or clash

tasks.task: Run the weekly trading review and calendar

items.when: Every Monday, with a short Thursday stock check before the weekend
When you must decide what to feature, push and reorder, and whether a markdown moves on
When you need every size and colour ranked by sales, units and refunds, with stock
When the trading calls must become a 30 day plan of what to push and which offers to run
When a featured collection shows sizes that are sold out and needs a daily check
When the plan comes from the report alone and nobody has asked staff or shoppers what they see

tasks.task: Plan markdowns and clear slow stock

items.when: When you have stock, sales and cost exports and need each product sorted with a markdown path
When you need the list of products with stock and no sales in 90 days, at cost value
When you need the dates and depth of each price cut to sell out by a set day
Before cutting price, to try a gift, bundle or pre-order route that protects the price
After a markdown, to check units sold and left and cash recovered against what the stock cost

tasks.task: Set collection sort and homepage slot rules

items.when: When the rules must follow each product's role: hero, push, clear or cut
When the homepage needs a fixed list of feature slots and what earns each one
When in-stock products must move to the top of a live collection and sold-out ones down
When you want to test a collection's top row against stock by size

tasks.task: Review the range: keep, cut or reorder

items.when: When each product needs sell-through, weeks of cover, margin and trend side by side
When the review must show each product's margin and the ones that lose money
When the range is too wide and you want a keep and cut plan drawn as a simple grid
When next season's buy must be split into early, held back and markdown dates

tasks.task: Write collection page intros for featured ranges

items.when: When a collection needs its title, heading, two-part intro and questions for one search term
When the intro's first line is flat, to get several honest angles to choose from
When an intro could describe any shop, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite

tasks.task: Fix pages where shoppers hesitate at the price

items.when: When you know what buyers doubt and need each doubt tied to a page section and real proof
When the price looks high alone, to try tier and anchor layouts that show value without tricks
When reviews exist but sit far from the price, to pick which proof goes where
When the page is changed, to get ranked fixes for variants, proof, buttons and price

tasks.task: Design a simple VIP programme

items.when: When you have order history and want the best-customer profile and programme in one run
When you know spend tiers and margins and want perks that are not discounts, with a test
When a full programme is too much, to try a personal touch plan for the top 50 first
When you must check that the perks leave margin on a typical VIP order

tasks.task: Plan a digital product ladder, listings and emails

items.when: When a creator has one or two downloads and wants a range from free to bundle
When the ladder needs a free first step worth an email address
When each step needs a price, a label and a launch discount
When a listing gets views but few sales and needs a title, bullets and description
When buyers need a delivery email and follow-ups that lead to the next step

tasks.task: Plan a product or range launch

items.when: When a new product has a date and needs timing, channels and announcement copy
When you want a teaser and preview route with a sign-up page before launch day
When the launch runs to a close date and the list needs a planned run of emails
Before go-live, to check the store, re-check after each fix and get a clear go or no-go

tasks.task: Plan a promotion and check every sale price

items.when: When a sale needs a main offer, backups and a subscriber plan from stock and margin
Before a sale, to find the deepest discount the margin allows and the wording to use
Before a markdown goes live, to check each was-price, percentage, deadline and delivery charge
When you must choose how to show the saving so it is clear and true

tasks.task: Review shipping rates and delivery costs

items.when: When you need what is charged against what is paid, by carrier and method
When the store needs zones, rates and a free-shipping line ready to enter
When some countries cannot check out, to list zones with no rate or only manual ones

tasks.task: Plan stock reorders against cash

items.when: When each product needs a sales forecast, a reorder date and a quantity
Each week, to see what to reorder, what it costs and whether cash can cover it
When the reorder list should follow this week's trading calls, not last month's

always.when: Before any margin, threshold or sell-through figure goes to the owner, to test the sums
Before any shopper-facing wording goes live, to sort each claim as fine, needs proof or cut

helpers.when: When product pages or many collection pages need full copy, not one intro
When the plan needs margin per order, customer segments or a sales change explained first
When the structure or bundles must be built in the store's theme, apps and settings
When a clean feed must be turned into Shopping campaigns and bids
When the VIP programme or post-purchase plan needs its emails written and run
When reorders depend on supplier lead times, minimums and freight

gaps: No library item builds a category tree with attributes and allowed values for each category; only the kit skill covers it
No library item gives two or three category tree options tested on real shopper tasks, such as a card sort or tree test
No library item writes a product data template or import sheet with allowed values for each field
No library item maps every product from an old catalogue structure to a new one with redirects
No library item reads Meta Commerce Manager catalogue diagnostics; feed items cover Google only
No library item builds a supplemental feed or writes rules for a feed tool
No library item plans a weekly trading calendar or homepage slot rules for a store
No library item checks was-prices against price history rules such as the lowest price in the last 30 days
No library item covers digital downloads: a product ladder, preview images, use rules in plain words and the delivery email
No library item tunes on-site search: synonyms, no-result searches and pinned results
No thinking lens in the library covers retail merchandising or how shoppers sort and find products
